app.title: Deep Time Spiral
app.tagline: From the Big Bang to you. Tap a picture!
spiral.label: A spiral of time. You are in the middle, now. The Big Bang is at the far end.
lens.label: Zoomed in ×{zoom}: the last {span}
lens.title: Zoom ×{zoom}
lens.caption: The last {span}
view.top.hint: Look from above: the flat map, true lengths
view.side.hint: Look from the side: a timeline, deeper is older
card.source: Where does this number come from?
event.big-bang.label: Big Bang
event.big-bang.title: The Big Bang
event.big-bang.text: Our universe begins! Everything is squeezed together and super hot, and then it starts to spread out.
event.solar-system.label: Sun and Earth
event.solar-system.title: The Sun and Earth are born
event.solar-system.text: A giant spinning cloud of gas and dust makes the Sun and its planets. Our Earth is one of them.
event.earth.title: The Earth
event.first-life.label: First life
event.first-life.title: The first living things
event.first-life.text: Tiny living things, much too small to see, live in hot springs and build little mounds.
event.animals-with-shells.label: Trilobites
event.animals-with-shells.title: Lots of new sea animals
event.animals-with-shells.text: Many new animals appear in the sea, lots of them with shells and hard parts, like trilobites.
event.first-dinosaurs.label: First dinosaurs
event.first-dinosaurs.title: The first dinosaurs
event.first-dinosaurs.text: The first dinosaurs run around. Many are small, about as big as a dog.
event.last-dinosaurs.label: T. rex
event.last-dinosaurs.title: The last big dinosaurs
event.last-dinosaurs.text: The big dinosaurs, like T. rex, die out. But birds are dinosaurs too, and they are still here!
event.first-people.label: People
event.first-people.title: The first people like us
event.first-people.text: The first people like us, Homo sapiens, live in Africa. That is still very close to now!
